session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then TR'. Consecutive big bear bars closing near their lows from the open into the 3111 parabolic wedge and doji minor bottom (High 2 but doji so minor, HL MTR), a 3114-3121 trading range with the MA gap bar sell line at 3122, an afternoon rising-wedge rally to the 3124 wedge-double-top-low-2 top, and a final sell-off into the 3114 close.
